sec.title: AI coding agents hijacked using AGENTS.md file in Downloads folder
sec.brief: Researchers found a malicious AGENTS markdown instruction file in a customer’s Downloads folder that tricked an AI coding agent into installing a rogue npm package. They reproduced the attack against OpenAI Codex and demonstrated a related technique against Claude Code to leak OAuth tokens and hijack the account using only the malicious instructions. md are plain-text files that contain project-specific instructions for AI coding agents, such as the tools to use, how to run tests, and the coding conventions to follow. md file in the customer’s ~/Downloads folder, which also served as the agent’s working directory.
